capabilities: Extract text from images via OCR
Extract text from PDFs and Office documents
Cache extracted texts as local JSON files
Expose an extractText() API for other plugins
extras: Marked unmaintained (pull requests and forks welcome) and still a beta; requires an Internet connection to download Tesseract language files (processing is local); text extraction does not work on mobile, which falls back to synced cache files.
motivation: The author wanted a unified text-extraction service so other plugins can use it without reimplementing it or consuming extra resources.
problem: Text extraction is hard to implement and resource-hungry, so plugins like Omnisearch cannot easily search inside images and PDFs.

relations.evidence: It's mainly useful when used in conjunction with other plugins (like Omnisearch)

summary: OCR companion plugin that extracts text from images, PDFs, and Office documents and exposes it to other plugins via an API.
